items: 【Product specifications】Package contains 2 pack 65” tall garden trellis. Each 65" high x 10" wide garden trellis with 3 adjustable durable plastic support rings. The height of this trellis for climbing plants indoor can be adjusted by increasing or decreasing the connecting rings based on the growth of the plant. Provide ample space for your climbing plants and vines to support the plants well to grow upright and healthy.

【Durable Material】The plant trellis indoor consists of metal poles with a plastic casing that is rust-proof. Plastic coating prevent internal steel tubes from rusting contains UV inhibitors to resist sun damage and fading, gentle to plant stems. NOTE: The rods are metal pipes with a thick plastic coating, and the support rings and decor heads are plastic.

【Unique Design】This trellis for climbing plants outdoor is designed with a mushroom top decoration, which will make your garden look unique and different. Many bumps designed on metal tubes will guide plants climb higher,and help them stay firmly on the trellis even in harsh weather.

【Easy To Install】Our garden trellis for climbing plants structure is simple, only need to assemble each component in order according to the manual, no screws or any specialized tools for assembly. NOTE: Pre-drill holes in the ground, install the longest four plastic pipes to the bottom layer to help push the trellis for potted plants into the ground. Suggest the stake length that insert into soil more than 6inches for great stability.

【Widely Application】This climbing plant support provide superior strength and sturdy support to climb for flowering vines, roses, climbing plants, tomato, pea, cucumber, blackberry, house plant and other plants. And you can also use garland for holiday decorations and transform any garden into a beautiful floral haven or use fairy lights for a magical nighttime scene for the perfect decorative piece for your yard, garden, or outdoor walkway.
